stories.title: Amid internal doubts, PTI affirms Sohail Afridi 'remains KP chief minister'
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The PTI on Thursday reaffirmed its support for Sohail Afridi, the ex-chief minister who was rendered nonfunctional after the imposition of governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, ruling out any move within the party to consider an alternative candidate for the office.

stories.title: Crypto giant Binance hit by $6.3bn hack suspected to be largest in history
stories.brief: Two analytics firms have attributed the incident to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.

stories.title: From workshops to the catwalk - why mended clothes are going mainstream
stories.brief: A new generation is embracing eye-catching patching and visible mends.

stories.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI fears rattle Wall Street
stories.brief: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

stories.title: Singapore FM arrives in Islamabad for 'comprehensive talks' with Dar
stories.brief: Singapore's Foreign Minister Dr Vivian Balakrishnan arrived in Islamabad on Friday, set to have "comprehensive talks" with Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar "on the cooperation in bilateral and multilateral domains," the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) said.

stories.title: Sana assures family access to Noreen
stories.brief: "Let me ask the relevant authorities about the claim that the relatives of Noreen Niazi have not been allowed to see her," Sanaullah said. Addressing concerns over the facilities available to Imran in custody, Sanaullah said reports on the ground situation, including amenities, food and other services, had been submitted to the Supreme Court.

stories.title: Govt stands firm on petroleum levy
stories.brief: Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal on Thursday ruled out the possibility of an immediate reduction in petroleum levy rates under any pressure from Jamaat-e-Islami but said that the government would consider a gradual decrease in rates from the next budget.

stories.title: PM pledges medical care for all
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Friday announced the government will bear 100 per cent of treatment costs for patients at the Pakistan-China Friendship Hospital, ensuring that no one is deprived of medical care because of financial constraints.

stories.title: Pakistan, KSA discuss farm investment
stories.brief: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia discussed expanding economic cooperation in agriculture, minerals and mining, and other sectors with investment potential, according to a statement issued by the Ministry of Finance on Thursday.

stories.title: PTI, TTAP throw weight behind Fazl
stories.brief: In a statement shared on X, former National Assembly speaker Asad Qaiser said a delegation comprising him, PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan and TTAP spokesperson Hussain Ahmad Yousafzai met Fazl at his residence in Islamabad.

stories.title: Who should pay on the first date?
stories.brief: Yasmin Rufo asks New Yorkers who picks up the bill on a first date, and how much they usually spend.

stories.title: Watch: What leaked audio reveals about Spain train crash
stories.brief: Recordings between a control centre and the train drivers appear to show one train was given clearance to move even though another train had stalled on the track.

stories.title: Your pay, energy bills and savings: How the Budget affects you
stories.brief: Changes announced by Chancellor John Healey in his first Budget will affect your finances directly.

stories.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
stories.brief: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

stories.brief: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.

stories.brief: The visiting dignitary is undertaking the trip at the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, who is scheduled to hold “comprehensive talks” with Balakrishnan on cooperation in bilateral and multilateral domains, according to the FO statement.

stories.title: Sindh govt to launch internship programme for new graduates next month: Sharjeel
stories.brief: KARACHI: Sindh Senior Minister Sha­r­jeel Inam Memon has announ­ced that an internship programme for fresh graduates is being launched from next month through the iwork4Sindh platform. He said that the programme would provide young people with better opportunities to gain practical experience.
